question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An utter state of confusion
solution:
The correct answer is: **Chaos**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Chaos"** means a state of utter confusion and disorder. (अव्यवस्था)

 
 
• **Example:** The sudden blackout during the event caused chaos among the audience.
 
 
 
• It is used to describe situations where no order or organization is present, often leading to panic or disturbance. (अराजकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The marketplace was in chaos after the unexpected announcement of a curfew.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Chaos**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pathos** (भावुकता): A quality in art or literature that evokes pity or sadness.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was filled with pathos, leaving the audience in tears.
 
 
 
• **Engross** (डुबाना): To occupy the attention or focus of someone completely.
 
 
• **Example:** She was so engrossed in her book that she didn’t notice the time.
 
 
 
• **Innuendos** (इशारे): Indirect or subtle references, often implying something derogatory.
 
 
• **Example:** The politician’s speech was filled with innuendos about his opponent.
